tw: Kron tunes his shortwave radio on the shore, and short sharks wave from the waves.
twc: Kron 在海边调短波收音机，几条矮矮的鲨鱼从浪里冲他挥鳍。

tw: Kron takes the sideway beside the highway, and a crab rides by sideways.
twc: Kron 走公路旁的小岔路，一只螃蟹横着骑车从他身边经过。
hint: 小路上，连骑车都横着来。

tw: Simple-minded Kron finds a dimpled, pimply pumpkin and minds it like a kind nanny.
twc: 单纯的 Kron 捡到个带酒窝的疙瘩南瓜，像保姆一样照看它。

tw: Kron skillfully stacks full skillets on his skull, still and fully balanced.
twc: Kron 熟练地把装满的平底锅一个个叠在头顶，稳稳当当。
hint: 手艺好，头顶也能当灶台。

tw: Kron is skipping rope on a ship, slipping and tipping as the ship dips.
twc: Kron 在船上跳绳，船一沉他就一滑一歪。

tw: Kron pokes a dragon: "Smoke-free tree!" So the dragon chokes out three free bubbles.
twc: Kron 戳戳龙：“这棵树禁烟！”龙只好咳出三个泡泡。
hint: 禁烟区里，龙只能吐泡泡。

tw: Kron throws a soft softball, and it falls off the loft onto a tall doll.
twc: Kron 轻轻投出垒球，球掉下阁楼，正砸中一个高个子玩偶。

tw: Kron drinks a pink soft drink and lifts off the sink, up to the loft.
twc: Kron 喝了杯粉色汽水，从水池边一飞冲上了阁楼。

tw: Kron buys souvenirs near the pier: soup spoons, deer ears and a very weird beard.
twc: Kron 在码头边买纪念品：汤勺、鹿耳朵和一把很怪的胡子。
hint: 纪念品全穿戴在身上了。

tw: Kron and his step-mother step on stepping stones as a huge moth smothers them both.
twc: Kron 和继母踩着石头过河，大飞蛾扑上来把俩人罩住。

tw: Kron clicks the stopwatch to watch a frog hop, stop, and wash a hot pot.
twc: Kron 按下秒表，看青蛙跳一跳、停一停，再刷个热锅。

tw: Kron naps in the sun on a giant bun and turns sunburnt like burnt toast.
twc: Kron 躺在大面包上晒太阳睡着了，晒得像烤焦的吐司。

tw: Kron tastes the tasteless paste, makes a face, and spits a mess on his dress.
twc: Kron 尝了口没味的糊糊，皱眉一喷，喷了自己一裙子。

tw: Kron's taxi carries three fax machines tax-free, and a flea relaxes on the stack.
twc: Kron 的出租车免税拉了三台传真机，跳蚤在上面躺着晒太阳。
hint: 免税通道，跳蚤也搭便车。

tw: Kron tells jokes in the telephone-booth till an elephant phones back: "Boo!"
twc: Kron 在电话亭里打电话讲笑话，一头大象回电：“嘣！”
hint: 恶作剧电话，被大象回敬。

tw: Thirsty Kron finds a mouse in his thermos on Thursday, sipping all the moss tea.
twc: 周四口渴的 Kron 打开保温瓶，一只老鼠正在里面喝青苔茶。

tw: In Tokyo, a toad in a kimono gives Kron the key: "Oh, go, go!"
twc: 在东京，一只穿和服的蛤蟆把钥匙塞给 Kron：“快走快走！”
hint: 东京第一站：被蛤蟆催着走。

tw: Jolly Kron drives the trolley-bus, and a collie with a lolly hops on the bus.
twc: 快活的 Kron 开着无轨电车，一只柯利犬举着棒棒糖跳上车。
hint: 司机的眼睛跟着棒棒糖走了。

tw: Kron leads ten geese trooping round the pool, all hula-hooping and whooping.
twc: Kron 带着十只鹅排队绕着泳池走，个个转着呼啦圈欢叫。

tw: Kron puts twenty-one candles on one bun, and plenty of twin piglets puff: done!
twc: Kron 在小面包上插了二十一根蜡烛，双胞胎小猪们一口吹灭。
hint: 愿望还没许，蜡烛先没了。
